relic.relic_aerial_master.name: AERIAL MASTER
relic.relic_aerial_master.description: Increase all Gunner damage by 30% while airborne.
relic.relic_air_master.name: AIR MASTER
relic.relic_air_master.description: Increase air control by 40% and gain one extra Dash in the air.
relic.relic_apex_predator.name: APEX PREDATOR
relic.relic_apex_predator.description: Deal 40% more damage to Elites and Bosses.
relic.relic_armor_shred.name: ARMOR SHRED
relic.relic_armor_shred.description: Machine Gun hits make enemies take 10% more damage for 2 seconds.
relic.relic_bullet_time.name: BULLET TIME
relic.relic_bullet_time.description: Recover the Dash cooldown twice as fast while airborne.
relic.relic_covering_fire.name: COVERING FIRE
relic.relic_covering_fire.description: Machine Gun hits slow enemies by 5% for 0.5 seconds.
relic.relic_dash_refund.name: DASH REFUND
relic.relic_dash_refund.description: Dash hits immediately restore 30% of the Dash cooldown.
relic.relic_death_mark.name: DEATH MARK
relic.relic_death_mark.description: Enemies killed by the Cannon explode for area damage. Each extra stack increases the explosion damage by 25%.
relic.relic_double_jump.name: DOUBLE JUMP
relic.relic_friendly_shield.name: FRIENDLY SHIELD
relic.relic_friendly_shield.description:
Reduce Cannon self-damage by 50% per stack.
At two stacks, Cannon self-damage is completely negated.
relic.relic_glass_cannon.name: GLASS CANNON
relic.relic_glass_cannon.description: Deal 20% more damage, but take 15% more damage.
relic.relic_ground_pound.name: GROUND POUND
relic.relic_ground_pound.description:
Land after falling at least {minimumFallDistance} m to create a shockwave.
Greater falls deal more damage and increase the radius, up to {maximumRadius} m.
Each stack adds {baseDamagePerStack} base damage.
relic.relic_hearty_tank.name: HEARTY TANK
relic.relic_hearty_tank.description:
Increase maximum integrity by {amount}.
The gained capacity is repaired immediately.
relic.relic_heat_sink.name: HEAT SINK
relic.relic_heat_sink.description: After firing the Cannon, increase Machine Gun damage by 20% for 3 seconds.
relic.relic_he_payload.name: HE PAYLOAD
relic.relic_he_payload.description: Increase Cannon blast radius and knockback by 30%.
relic.relic_iron_will.name: IRON WILL
relic.relic_iron_will.description: Take 20% less damage while integrity is at or below 50%.
relic.relic_last_resort.name: LAST RESORT
relic.relic_last_resort.description: Deal 25% more damage while integrity is at or below 30%.
relic.relic_magnet_core.name: MAGNET CORE
relic.relic_momentum_shield.name: MOMENTUM SHIELD
relic.relic_momentum_shield.description: Take 20% less damage while moving at top speed.
relic.relic_phase_dash.name: PHASE DASH
relic.relic_phase_dash.description: Become invulnerable during Dash. Can only be acquired once.
relic.relic_phoenix_core.name: PHOENIX CORE
relic.relic_phoenix_core.description: Once per run, survive a wipeout with 50% integrity and release a shockwave.
relic.relic_rapid_reload.name: RAPID RELOAD
relic.relic_rapid_reload.description: Cannon hits reduce the next Cannon cooldown by 20%.
relic.relic_roadkill.name: ROADKILL
relic.relic_roadkill.description: High-speed collisions deal more damage at higher speeds. Each extra stack increases collision damage by 25%.
relic.relic_safe_haven.name: SAFE HAVEN
relic.relic_safe_haven.description: Repair {amount} integrity when a wave is cleared.
relic.relic_twin_shell.name: TWIN SHELL
relic.relic_twin_shell.description: Each stack adds one Cannon shell to every firing sequence. Cannon cooldown is increased by 20% while owned.
relic.relic_unstoppable.name: UNSTOPPABLE
relic.relic_unstoppable.description: Dash has no cooldown. Increase Dash damage by 50%.
relic.relic_vampire_rounds.name: VAMPIRE ROUNDS
relic.relic_xp_surge.name: XP SURGE
